{{Quote|You sound like a festerin' jizz-box. I got a festerin' jizz-box right over there in that corner.|The assistant manager of the Wookiee's Codpiece|<ref name="PT" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] was the '''assistant manager''' of a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] called the [[Wookiee's Codpiece]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nim Drovis]].<ref name="PT" /> In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' is set thirteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] auditioned to perform [[Music/Legends|music]] at the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee's]] Codpiece. Once the assistant manager heard the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] playback songs from his [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]], the Human rejected C-3PO and compared him to a festering [[jizz-box]] akin to one the Wookiee's Codpiece already possessed.<ref name="PT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assistant manager was mentioned in ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', a [[1997]] novel by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="PT" />
